description: This source file provides a function to configure a device over a serial connection using a configuration shell script. It manages serial communication, file transfer, checksum validation, and execution of configuration commands on the device.

classes.name: SerialDevice
classes.description: A class representing a serial communication interface with a device, used for sending and expecting specific strings over the serial connection.

methods.name: configure_device(device: GenericDevice, configuration_file: Path)
methods.description: Configures a device over a serial connection by sending configuration commands from a file, verifying the file's integrity via MD5 checksum, and executing the configuration script on the device.
